title: Circle with Marked Features
description: A circle with its center and 1–3 features (radius, diameter, chord, tangent line, or central angle), each placed by angle and labeled. Serves Geometry and Trigonometry (circles): radius/diameter relationships, arc length, central angles, area, and circle-equation questions.

center.description: Center coordinates in the figure frame.

radius.description: Figure-units radius; bounds keep every feature inside the canvas.

features.description: Marked circle elements. angleDegrees positions the feature on the circle (0° = 3 o'clock, counterclockwise).

angleDegrees.description: Primary placement angle; for central_angle this is the start of the arc.

sweepDegrees.description: Required for central_angle (arc extent); ignored otherwise.

centerLabel.description: Label at the center dot (commonly 'O'); null hides it.

notes: Renderer guarantees: every feature is constructed from center + radius + angles (a diameter is the segment through center at angleDegrees, a tangent is perpendicular to the radius at that point) — lengths in labels are never geometric data, so figure and geometry cannot conflict; features must be at least 20° apart at the circumference (validated) so labels never collide; no axes are drawn unless a future coordinate variant requires them.
